steps: studio-lab, place a music clip (pulse 2-6) and Soft impact @8 on SFX
Start a header drag on the music clip with pointer 7 (cross-lane to stems, or same lane) and do not release
With a second pointer (touch id 21), drag the impact clip header +1 s and release; or click the SFX lane M button
bugs.expected: Either the second-pointer edit is blocked while a gesture is active (D-20/D-23 spirit), or it is preserved by the first gesture's commit; the history matches the arrangement
bugs.actual: The second edit commits first (history 'კლიპის გადატანა' impact->9, or 'Mute — SFX'). The first gesture's preview or commit is rebuilt from gesture.before and silently reverts it (impact back to 8, SFX mute back to false). The history keeps the lost entry. During a cross-lane drag, the second gesture's release also clears the lane ghost and Shift hint.
bugs.evidence: c-round-5.md §5 C-R5-02. Browser runs: cross-lane {g2: sfx 9 -> after: sfx 8, music 4}, same-lane {mid sfx 9 -> after sfx 8}, mute {mid aria-pressed true -> after false}. Cause: ArrangementClip.tsx commitArrangement(laneTarget.arrangement / getArrangement(), label, gesture.before) with previews built from gesture.before. Existed before round 5 (code-reviewer #7, A known gap). HEAD ArrangementClip.tsx lines 232-275 already build previews from gesture.before; round 5 extends the pattern to the cross-lane commit.

steps: Open /studio-lab at 1280x720 or 1440x900 with the library at the default 288 px
Look at the source list under 'ყველა ფაილი'
bugs.expected: Each list row shows the sound's name readably, so the 4 synthetic stems can be told apart
bugs.actual: Title span is 110 px wide; 7 of 9 titles are truncated. pulse, bass, pad, melody and the mix all read 'ღამის პულსი…'. The stem name appears only in the tooltip, the preview panel or after widening the panel. Regression: the C-R4-03 tree fix (w-36) narrowed the list column from 192 to 144 px.

blocked: RF5-1b passed only on the natural reload series, which had 0 episodes with |d| > 0.12. No natural escalation was observed. The forced diagnostic proved the path (320 ms). B decision: under a persistent lag, the counted time between escalations can reach about 700 ms (seeked + 300 ms exclusion to seeked + 1000 ms limit), which exceeds the 600 ms FAIL threshold. Shorten the limit or redefine the rule. The decoder-ramp scenario needs Tech Lead real Windows Chrome (VP9 + H.264).
